Based on my search, I can provide you with information about **CFA Institute** (the organization that administers the Chartered Financial Analyst program). Since your query "cfa ins" was brief, I'll cover the key aspects:

## What is CFA Institute?

CFA Institute is the global professional organization that administers the **CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst)** program, one of the most respected credentials in investment management and financial analysis.

## Key Information About CFA Institute Membership & Fees (2026)

### Exam Registration Fees (2026 - Updated Structure)

Starting from February 2026, CFA Institute **abolished the one-time $350 enrollment fee**. Now there are only registration fees per level:

| Level | Early Registration | Standard Registration |
|-------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Level I & II | $1,140 | $1,490 |
| Level III | $1,240 | $1,590 |

### Annual Membership Dues

After earning your charter, you must maintain **active membership** to use the CFA designation:

- **CFA Institute Global Dues:** **$299/year** (required)
- **Local Society Dues:** Vary by region (e.g., CFA Society India collects dues in INR)

### Membership Types

| Type | Requirements | Benefits |
|------|-----------|----------|
| **Regular Membership** | Pass Level I + 4,000 hours of relevant work experience (36+ months) + references | Required for CFA charter; voting rights; full access to resources |
| **Affiliate Membership** | Pass Level I only | Access to research, learning content, network; no charter eligibility |

### Requirements to Earn the CFA Charter

1. Pass all 3 exam levels
2. Complete 4,000 hours of **investment-related** work experience (minimum 36 months)
3. Submit 2-3 professional references
4. Apply for regular membership with CFA Institute **and** join a local CFA society

### Total Estimated Costs

| Scenario | Total Cost (USD) |
|----------|----------------|
| Minimum (early registration, no retakes, no prep materials) | ~$3,570–$3,860 |
| Realistic (with prep materials, possible retake) | $7,000–$9,500 |
| Maximum (multiple retakes, premium materials) | $12,000+ |

### Important Notes

- You can **lose your charter** if you stop paying annual membership dues or commit serious ethics violations
- Membership applications typically take up to 10 business days for CFA Institute review, plus up to 1 month for local society review
- Indian candidates should note: 18% GST applies on international forex transactions when paying fees

If you had a more specific question about CFA Institute (e.g., exam dates, scholarships, specific society information, or study materials), please let me know and I can search for more targeted information.

2. https://capstonelearnings.com/cfa-vs-frm-india/

4. https://cfasocietyindia.org/membership/
